title: Board
description: A member's personal board (DynamoDB GlobalPerspectiveSavedItems item kind:'board'). Pins are things the member follows (a story thread, a country, an actor); strings are the links between two pins, drawn by us (owner ours) or by the member (owner yours). Pin budget is 12 live pins; a retired pin (retiredAt) is greyed, keeps its strings and does not count toward it. String endpoints a and b are pinIds and MUST satisfy a < b lexically so there is one key per pair; JSON Schema cannot enforce ordering, so newsBoard normalises it with pairKey. refId by kind: thread = threadId, country = ISO3, actor = the actor name as written in WEB#INDEX (trimmed, whitespace collapsed; compared case-insensitively).

pins.description: At most 12 live pins (checked in code: retired pins do not count); the array may also hold up to 28 retired ones.

weights.description: The member's own branch weights: {forkId: {branchId: number 0..1}}.

dismissed.description: refIds the member dismissed from suggestions.

presetFrom.description: Preset this board was forked from.

lastVisitedAt.description: Server-stamped arrival watermark, advanced after the tray is read.

refId.description: threadId, ISO3, or actor name as in WEB#INDEX.

retiredAt.description: Set when the member retires the pin: it is drawn greyed, keeps its strings and lines, and does not count toward the pin budget. Restore clears it.

a.description: pinId; must be lexically less than b (enforced in code).

b.description: pinId; must be lexically greater than a (enforced in code).

line.description: The member's own one-line claim about the link.
